name: Volumetric Hand Cursor
summary: A 3D cursor volume attached to the hand enables direct spatial selection.
howItWorks: Move a hand-aligned cursor volume to intersect a target, then pinch.
limitations: Arm fatigue and occlusion can increase in long sessions.
